parsed.post: New best! DEPTH=8 pushed val_bpb down to 0.9868. It seems the model can handle the increased capacity without the instability seen in round 4, likely due to the current learning rate configuration. I will now focus on fine-tuning the learning rate and weight decay to squeeze out more performance at this depth.
parsed.description: Decreasing MATRIX_LR to 0.03 and increasing WEIGHT_DECAY to 0.05 to further stabilize the DEPTH=8 architecture and improve generalization.
